whiteouts.effect: remove matching prior path or subtree

releaseSourceFileChanges.changeSummary: Comments out the 128-attempt limit, warning, and false return in the repeated course-identifier allocation guard.

conclusion: The pinned image base source layer is byte-for-byte identical to the official Claroline 1.11.10 archive. Later layers add generated runtime configuration/cache, remove the installer directory, and alter one source file by commenting out a retry limit guard. The source release is verified; the final image is a derived/customized image with one unattributed application-code patch. Do not describe the image as a pristine release build.
